judged_text: Neither limit nor offset is validated in groups_controller#members; a negative offset produces an invalid SQL OFFSET error

record.issue_text: Neither limit nor offset is validated in groups_controller#members; a negative offset produces an invalid SQL OFFSET error

adjudication.rationale: In `GroupsController#members`, the code takes `offset = params[:offset].to_i` and then directly calls `group.users.order(:username_lower).limit(limit).offset(offset)`. There is no clamping/validation to ensure `offset >= 0`. If a request supplies a negative offset (e.g. `?offset=-10`), `.to_i` will yield `-10` and ActiveRecord will generate SQL with `OFFSET -10`, which PostgreSQL rejects ("OFFSET must not be negative"), causing a 500 error. Although the JS client clamps offset before requesting, the controller itself does not validate it, so the issue is real at the API level.
